Once upon a time, a small fox found a red ball beside the river. The fox rolled it home and shared it with a friend. They played until sunset and promised to meet again.<|endoftext|>
Mina wanted to bake a cake, but she had never baked one before. Her father showed her how to measure flour and crack an egg. The cake leaned to one side, yet everyone agreed it tasted wonderful.<|endoftext|>
On a rainy morning, Leo heard a soft chirp near the window. A wet bird was hiding under a leaf. Leo made a little shelter, and by afternoon the bird was ready to fly home.<|endoftext|>
The old blue kite was stuck in a tall tree. Ava and Sam tied two broom handles together, but they were still too short. A gust of wind finally freed the kite, and the children cheered.<|endoftext|>
